title: Gaia ASan tests need GCC maybe-uninitialized warning demotion
body: The queued ASan build of tmp/schedwitness-run8-asan failed because GCC 15 promotes maybe-uninitialized diagnostics from GAIA_MEM_SANI_ADD_BLOCK in include/gaia/mem/mem_sani.h to errors. I reconfigured the consumer ASan tree with -Wno-error=maybe-uninitialized so the sanitizer target can compile. Consolidate the compiler-version warning policy in the Gaia ASan test setup so each lane does not need a consumer-side override.

title: Queue reservation scan tolerates concurrent file cleanup
body: During bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent schedwitness --resource light --label gaia-world-lock-header -- bash make_single_header.sh, the live queue printed /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh: line 582: /tmp/undertow-box-memory-reservation.409719: No such file or directory while scanning the reservation glob. Admission retried automatically and header generation later exited 0. Make the reservation scan tolerate a file removed between globbing and reading it, without emitting an error or interrupting an admitted job.
